children: Jonathan Blanchard, Chief Financial Officer (analyst calls)

NEXT plc's Half Year Report to 1 August 2026 has been submitted in full unedited text to the Financial Conduct Authority's National Storage Mechanism and will be available shortly for inspection at https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism.
The results are also available at http://www.rns-pdf.londonstockexchange.com/rns/0972V_1-2026-9-16.pdf and on the NEXT corporate website www.nextplc.co.uk.

The Board has declared an interim ordinary dividend of 98 pence per share to be paid on 4 January 2027.  Shares will trade ex-dividend from 3 December 2026 and the record date will be 4 December 2026.
